visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two young women sit in teal airplane seats. One wears a black tank top and a patterned bandana; the other wears a dark blue tank top and black shorts. They gesture toward white headphones on a center console tray while smiling. The lighting is bright and even, revealing a simulated airplane interior with a 'No Smoking' sign behind them. (2) Both women simultaneously place large white headphones over their ears, looking directly at the camera with bright smiles. The background remains constant, featuring the teal seat headrests and a gray cabin wall. (3) A series of rapid shots shows the women in different poses: arms crossed, holding open newspapers with large headlines, and then leaning their heads together while wearing blue neck pillows. Their facial expressions shift quickly from serious to joyful. (4) The woman in the bandana stands and lifts a large silver corrugated suitcase over her head in a playful manner. The other woman looks up with an exaggerated expression of surprise. A green 'EXIT' sign is visible on the left. (5) Both women sit back in their seats, waving their arms in the air and laughing. They appear to be cheering in an empty airplane cabin environment.

This is immediately followed by a rapid succession of five camera shutter 'click' sound effects, perfectly timed with a fast-paced editing rhythm.
